name: Hands in Soil
source:
Three teenagers make a vlog about taking a barren land and restoring it to make it a biodiversity haven.

[From [url=https://lyrdinn.itch.io/hands-in-soil]Itch.io[/url]]

三个青少年制作了一个视频博客，讲述如何将一片贫瘠的土地恢复原貌，使其成为生物多样性的天堂。

[来自[url=https://lyrdinn.itch.io/hands-in-soil]Itch.io[/url]]
